title: Summit Ledger Correction Standard
content:
Under this Crestline Summit Loyalty Program ledger standard, a posting made in error is corrected by reversal.

**Postings reversed.** A posting made in error, meaning the same segment credited twice, activity credited to the wrong member, or a partner posting the partner has cancelled, is reversed in full by one reversal entry naming the posting.

**Once only.** Each posting can be reversed at most once; a reversal entry already naming the posting means it is not reversed again.

**Balance floor.** A reversal may take the mile balance down only to zero; where the balance is below the miles the reversal removes, the remainder is left unrecovered and referred to a human representative.

**Disputed amounts.** A posting the member merely disputes the amount of is not reversed; the correct amount is re-derived under the earning rules and any shortfall is posted as a retro credit.

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** A duplicate posting of 3000 miles is reversed on a membership whose balance is 1800 miles. The balance goes to zero; the remaining 1200 miles are left unrecovered and referred to a human representative.

| Situation | Treatment |
|---|---|
| Same segment credited twice | The duplicate posting reversed in full |
| Credited to the wrong member | Reversed in full |
| Partner cancelled its posting | Reversed in full |
| Member disputes the amount only | Not reversed; amount re-derived and any shortfall posted as a retro credit |
